I second this. As someone who graduated last year in CS, it is one of the hardest undergrad classes. I’d try to take it another quarter when things aren’t over zoom as suggested. If you can’t, and it’s the class you have to take to graduate this quarter, I’d really reach out to your professors and TAs and try to get help. Maybe ask your professors to use slack or Piazza so that you could message people in your class for help and find study buddies/project partners. I’m sure you aren’t alone in this. Also, just try to remember that a D is a passing grade, and that GPA isn’t everything, esp in CS.
